name: Sprout for WooCommerce
author: hellosprout.ai

sections.description:
Sprout WooCommerce adds a chat bubble to WooCommerce stores, allowing store owners to offer real-time support. You can control the chat bubble’s visibility directly via the admin panel.

Please note: This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Key Features:

  • Activate or deactivate the chat bubble from the WooCommerce admin dashboard.
  • Automatically embeds the chat bubble script in the site’s <head> and <body>.
  • Easy setup with no technical knowledge required.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce stores of all sizes.

Contributors

hellosprout.ai

External Services

This plugin uses external services to enable chat functionality. Below are the details:

  1. Service Name: Sprout Chat Bubble
    URL: https://app.hellosprout.ai/chat/assets/chat-bubble.js
    Purpose: This script is used to render the chat bubble on your website.
    Data Sent: None directly by the script. The script facilitates user interaction with the chat service.
    Terms of Service: Sprout Terms of Service
    Privacy Policy: Sprout Privacy Policy

  2. Service Name: Sprout Web Chat
    URL: https://app.hellosprout.ai/chat
    Purpose: This service handles user interactions and data transmission for chat functionality.
    Data Sent: Includes the chatId (enterprise ID) for associating chat sessions with your account.
    Terms of Service: Sprout Terms of Service
    Privacy Policy: Sprout Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  2. Upload the sprout-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  3. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Sprout in the admin panel to configure chat bubble settings.
  5. Enter your Enterprise ID and use the toggle button to activate or deactivate the chat bubble.
sections.faq:
How do I activate the chat bubble?

Go to WooCommerce > Sprout in your admin panel, enter your Enterprise ID, and click Activate.

Where do I find my Enterprise ID?

Log into your Sprout account, go to Test & Integration, and copy your Enterprise ID for WooCommerce.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin will remove the chat bubble from the frontend, but your settings will remain saved for future use.
